top_call_exchanges.topic: Net Cash Usage Discipline & Liquidity Runway Without ATM
top_call_exchanges.question: Net cash usage came down to $28 million in Q3 with zero ATM issuance. Can you walk us through the sustainability of this low cash burn in Q4 and whether you anticipate needing external capital in the first half of 2027?
top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Jose Luis Crespo (CEO): 'Our $28 million net cash usage in Q3 is the direct fruit of disciplined operational execution across Project Quantum Leap. We reduced CapEx to under $15 million, improved internal supply chain velocity, and saw our hydrogen production plants in Georgia and Tennessee drive internal molecule cost savings. We expect net cash usage to improve further in Q4 and enter 2027 with a dramatically lower cash burn run-rate.'
top_call_exchanges.verdict: CASH USAGE CUT VERIFIED WITHOUT ATM

top_call_exchanges.topic: Gross Margin Inflection & Hydrogen Plant Cost Reductions
top_call_exchanges.question: Gross margin reached -2.67%, a ~65 percentage point YoY rebound. What portion of this is recurring cost improvement from your green hydrogen plants versus one-time inventory adjustments?
top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Jose Luis Crespo (CEO): 'Over 80% of this margin recovery is structural and recurring. In material handling, GenDrive unit costs fell as volumes rose. In fuel, producing our own hydrogen at $3 to $4 per kilogram internally rather than buying on the open merchant market at $10 to $12 per kilogram has fundamentally reshaped our unit economics, paving the path to positive gross margins in Q4.'

top_call_exchanges.topic: Arcadia eFuels 280 MW Contract & Global Electrolyzer Funnel
top_call_exchanges.question: How should we think about revenue recognition for the 280 MW Arcadia eFuels order and the timing of converting your $8 billion electrolyzer pipeline into firm revenue backlog?
top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Jose Luis Crespo (CEO): 'Project ENDOR in Denmark represents a marquee commercial win, positioning Plug across more than 1 GW of e-SAF projects. Manufacturing and module staging will begin in 2027 with revenue recognized through percentage-of-completion milestones. Across Australia, Canada, and Europe, our funnel is actively converting into booked customer commitments.'
